entries.bbbd5df3eb96635a: A business that provides comprehensive support to distribution and retail companies, including food supermarkets, from planning and proposing sales promotions through design to producing promotional materials such as flyer inserts; it is the company group's only segment. The securities report calls this service "ARSS (short for Aidma Retail Support System)." For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥4,761,878 thousand (down 14.8% from the previous year) and operating profit was ¥268,589 thousand (down 25.3% from the previous year). The securities report cites distribution and retail companies holding down sales promotion spending amid rising prices, and the shift of media as advertising channels such as retail media expanded, as the main reasons for the decline in revenue. Because it is a single segment, no amounts by segment are given.

entries.f6e0b8e075e3a6ac: A service that plans sales promotion measures from the analysis of marketing data, tailored to the characteristics of each client's market and area. The securities report states that, beyond simply collecting and analyzing big data, in-house staff well versed in distribution and retail handle everything from interpreting the analysis results to forming hypotheses. Specifically, it lists the collection and analysis of various marketing data and trend data, the planning and proposal of sales promotion concepts, sales promotion plans and policies for advertised products, and surveys of competing stores and competing markets. The content is running the PDCA cycle of planning, executing, evaluating and improving measures. The amount is not disclosed separately.
